relevance.rationale: A worked first-kind q-Borel-Laplace resummation of a divergent BILATERAL series whose connection coefficient is a q-elliptic theta quotient — the same shape as C1's connection-matrix entries ('elliptic per entry', bean qou-wgnx) and the precedent that bean's route (a) needs (resum in two directions lambda != mu, form S_q from the direction dependence). Read: §1 (1psi0 and Ramanujan's 1psi1 summation, eq. (1); the intro theorem), §2 (theta function, q-Borel and q-Laplace of first and second kind), §3.1 (eq. (19) the degenerate first-order equation ((1/q - ax)sigma_q + x)u = 0 with formal solution 1psi0, eq. (20), and the theta-normalised solution at infinity), §3.2 Thm 1 (the resummation in direction lambda equals (q;q)_inf/(q/a;q)_inf times theta(aq lambda)/theta(q lambda) times theta(ax/lambda)/theta(x/lambda) times 1/(1/ax;q)_inf off the q-spiral [-lambda;q]) and Cor 1 (C(x;q) is q-elliptic), §4 Thm 2 (q -> 1 gives the bilateral 1H0). Corpus-grep: 'bilateral' has one Lean hit (BalancedThetaLimit.lean, a bilateral theta series) and one compute hit (the theta-kernel bilateral Laplace of qbeta_g3_5two_qborel_theta_laplace.py, a different object: the Masbaum bar-side series); '1psi0' / 'bilateral basic hypergeometric' have no hits. So no block or witness evaluates 1psi0 and there is nothing to compute-check; the value is as a citable precedent beside morita2014 (bean qou-hnuw, todo) at the level-1 q-Borel kernel file. Not inflated to core: one theorem, order one, and no corpus number depends on it.

keyResults.statement: The first-kind q-Borel-Laplace resummation of 1psi0(a;-;q,x) in direction lambda is an explicit product of theta quotients times 1/(1/ax;q)_inf, valid off the q-spiral [-lambda;q]; the connection coefficient C(x;q) is q-elliptic.
keyResults.useForFolio: The simplest worked instance of the summation-direction dependence of a q-Borel-Laplace resummation sitting entirely in a theta quotient — the route-(a) precedent bean qou-wgnx names, one order below morita2014's.

keyResults.statement: 1psi0 is the divergent formal solution of the degenerate first-order q-difference equation ((1/q - ax)sigma_q + x)u = 0.
keyResults.useForFolio: A first-order divergent model equation for the level-1 kernel t_n = q^{C(n,2)} formalised in QBorelKernel.lean.
